verdict.rationale: Cold-start latency is a fair axis for an inference engine like vLLM, but nothing in the evidence documents a lightweight runtime binary or fast startup. The pack shows only a pip/uv-installed Python package, a source build and a Docker image, with no startup-time claims or measurements. The TTFT statistics measure per-request latency after the server is running, not engine cold start, so they don't count here.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can get a fast cold start from a lightweight runtime binary instead of waiting seconds before inference begins
